description:
Hushfeed v0.84.0 has 155 patches for global TikTok 47.9.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

TikTok moves to 47.9.3, so grab that build from APKMirror and keep the same signing key. Update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 first, because older ones won't load this bundle. New: Unfollow accounts that don't follow you back, Identify the song with Shazam, UI scale, Smaller text sizes and Keep likes on this phone. TikTok Lite 47.8.2 gets its first 11 patches.

All 155 patches applied to the supported APK. This bundle ran through a whole-app walk of TikTok on a signed-in Galaxy S22 with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Features

* `Long press` and `Double tap` can now be set to `Save this video`. It saves the video on screen the way the save button does, with your download settings, mini drama episodes included. It's offered when Advanced downloads is patched in (#463).
* With `Watch LIVEs unseen` on, letting a host see you now lasts for that visit only. Leave the LIVE and you're hidden again the next time you open it. Tap the open eye to stay hidden on your next visit without leaving.
* Three new LIVE options in Playback change the profile card a tap on a name opens in a LIVE room. `LIVE profile card background` paints the card black, dark gray, light gray or white, and `LIVE profile card text` picks the color of its text, or Automatic for whichever of white and black stands out. Chips, buttons and boxes on the card keep TikTok's colors. `Hide rows on LIVE profile cards` takes off the rows you pick: upcoming LIVE events, products, the shop and its rating, group chat, the bulletin board, the gift gallery and festival honors. They all start off and apply the next time a card opens (#487).
* `UI scale` is new on the App page. Set its `UI size` below 100 to make TikTok's whole interface smaller, text and buttons alike, so more fits on screen. It takes 50 to 100 and needs a restart, and 100 changes nothing. It works together with `Smaller text sizes`. inxomnyaa sent it in a pull request (#477).
* `Smaller text sizes` is new on the App page. It adds three stops below the smallest size on TikTok's own Text size slider, in Settings and privacy > Accessibility, so text and everything around it can be smaller than TikTok allows. Pick one there, then restart TikTok. Turning the switch off puts TikTok back on its own smallest size. It starts off. inxomnyaa sent it in a pull request (#476).
* `Show the room ID and your connection`, with the other LIVE options in Playback, adds a small line to LIVE rooms with the room's ID and how your own connection to the stream is doing. That's ping, latency and download speed, the same numbers TikTok's player keeps for its own LIVE debug panel. A number the player doesn't have for a stream is left out, and nothing about the host's phone is shown. Tap the line to copy the room ID. It starts off (#487).
* `Account facts on profiles` shows two more lines, the account's gifter level and its SecUID, both from what TikTok already sent with the profile. A detail TikTok left out now says Unknown (TikTok didn't send it) in place of Not sent. Hushfeed shows the username and display name change dates exactly as TikTok sends them, so when an older change has no date, it's TikTok that left it out (#487).
* `Round the corners on profile grids`, with the other profile grid options under Interface, gives each video on a profile grid 8dp rounded corners. It works on your own profile, anyone else's, the Liked and Favorites tabs, and the videos inside a Favorites collection. It starts off and turns on or off as the grid scrolls, no restart needed (#487).
* With `More opens the comments` or `Caption above comments` on, the caption at the top of the comments now shows in the language the feed shows it in. If TikTok translates the caption (Always translate, or See translation on that video), the comments get TikTok's own translation, hashtags and mentions included, and See original keeps it as posted. A translation TikTok hasn't fetched yet leaves the caption as posted until the next time you open the comments (#488).
* `Exit with one Back` is new on the Feed tabs page. One Back on Home leaves TikTok, with no "Tap again to exit" toast. From any other tab, Back still goes to Home first, or to the tab `Open TikTok on` picks. It starts off and doesn't need a restart (#489).
* `Hide the pause icon` is new on the Feed screen page. A tap still pauses and plays the video, but the big play icon doesn't pop up over it anymore. It starts off and doesn't need a restart (#489).
* `Hide playable games` is new under Feed filter. It takes the mini games tagged Playable out of For You before they show. A creator on your exceptions list keeps theirs. It starts off and needs a restart (#486).
* `Hide the Tako bubble` also covers the Tako icon some accounts get in the home top bar. inxomnyaa found where TikTok sets it up and sent the hook in a pull request (#475).
* Two new Comment tools switches for the comment sheet (#479). `Always show the expand button in comments` gives every video's comments the button that stretches them over the whole screen, which TikTok only hands to some accounts. `Keep the video full size under comments` stops the video from shrinking into a small box when the comments open, so they cover its lower part instead. Both start off and take a TikTok restart.
* `Share any comment`, under Comments, lets you share a comment or send it to a friend when TikTok says it can't be shared. TikTok's server marks those comments, and with the switch on the long-press menu treats them like any other. The link it shares is the video's link with the comment's id on it, the same kind TikTok makes for every comment. It's part of Comment tools and starts off (#481).
* On TikTok's own bottom bar, `Glass lens on the current tab` is a thin outline now, white on a dark bar and dark on a light one, with nothing filled inside, so it doesn't sit on the icons like a heavy frame. Sliding across the tabs works the same. The glass, floating and see-through bars keep the glass bubble (#483).
* A name typed after an @ in a bio, like @First Last, opens TikTok's search on the Accounts tab now, where the person is usually the first row. It used to open the Top results. A typed @username still opens that profile, and `Tap @names in bios` turns all of it off (#247).
* `Identify the song with Shazam` is a new choice for Long press and Double tap, the corners included. It takes 12 seconds from the middle of the video's sound, turns them into a Shazam fingerprint on your phone, and shows the song and artist with Copy and YouTube Music. Only the fingerprint goes to Shazam, never the audio, and only when you use the gesture. The fingerprint code is ported from SongRec.
* `Unfollow accounts that don't follow you back` is new under Privacy > Clean up your account. It reads who you follow and your followers first, with a running count and Stop, then tells you how many it found and counts down with Cancel before it unfollows them one at a time. An account only counts when your Following list marks it as followed and not mutual and it isn't on your followers list, so the people who follow you back stay followed.
* `Show what changed since your last visit`, under Profile, puts a line under the @username when you come back to a profile, like "Since Nov 18: +12 followers, +1 video". It covers followers, following, likes and videos. When your last visit was earlier the same day, it shows the time instead of the date. The counts stay on your phone, nothing is recorded while the switch is off, and a profile you haven't opened before shows nothing until your next visit. It starts off.
* `Export followers and following`, under Profile, saves your followers or the accounts you follow as a CSV file in Download/Hushfeed. Each row has the username, name, profile link and IDs, plus whether you follow each other. The list is read at about the pace of scrolling it, with a count and Stop, up to 10,000 accounts. Stop keeps the ones read so far, and the notice says the file is partial.
* `Save your likes from a TikTok data export`, under Downloads, saves the videos you liked or favorited. Ask TikTok for your data in JSON format (Settings and privacy > Account > Download your data), then pick the file it sends you, or the zip it comes in. Hushfeed tells you how many liked videos and favorites it found and you tick which to save. They save one after another with a count and Cancel, up to 1,000 per run. With `Check for already-saved videos` on, the ones you saved before are skipped, so picking the same file again carries on where the last run stopped. Videos TikTok doesn't have anymore are counted at the end.
* Ghost mode has a new switch, `Keep likes on this phone`. With it on, a like you give a video turns the heart red but never reaches TikTok, so the creator isn't told and the video stays off your profile's Liked tab. The heart is still red after you reopen TikTok. Unliking one takes it back on the phone. Unliking a video you liked before turning it on still goes to TikTok. `My likes on this phone`, right under it, lists them newest first and opens each video. TikTok's like count doesn't include them, and comment likes still go out.
* AMOLED dark theme has a new option, `Switch in Hushfeed settings`. It's on unless you turn it off, so your builds stay the same. Off, it leaves out the AMOLED dark mode switch, whose hooks change more of TikTok's code than any other Hushfeed patch, so patching needs less memory, and dark mode stays black. On a computer with every Hushfeed patch picked, the patcher rebuilt 1,777 classes with it off and 2,513 with it on.
* TikTok Lite 47.8.2 gets its first Hushfeed patches: Settings, Diagnostic tools, Feed filter, Change app name, Trust user certificates, Disable screen capture detection, Network request report, Block contact list access, Block installed app scanning, In-app browser privacy guard and Camera and microphone indicator. Lite has no For You tab to hold, so press and hold the app's icon and pick Open Hushfeed settings. The Feed filter works on For You and leaves a profile's videos and a video you opened alone (#48).
* `Liquid glass when held` brings the glass lens to your finger now, and it swells more. Move your finger along the bar and the lens goes with it, tab to tab, then slides back to your tab when you let go. The tab under it grows, and on Android 13 and up the tabs bend and split into color at the lens's edge, the way the video does with `Blur the video behind the bar` (#440).
* With `Keep watching in a small window` on, a LIVE's small window now has previous and next buttons, like a video's. They move to the LIVE above or below the way a swipe does, Record (or TikTok's own button) sits between them, and the one with no LIVE its way shows dimmed (#413).
* A save that a server turns down now shows up in the diagnostic report's new SAVE REFUSALS section. It names the server, says how it refused (like HTTP 403), and tells whether the save's link had already expired. Before, each refused address only read "url omitted" (#464).
* The diagnostic report's DOWNLOAD PICKER section also lists what's in the video models TikTok keeps beside a video's qualities, each rendition by name and height, so a report can show whether one of them is taller than what Save offers (#471).
* When TikTok freezes ("isn't responding") or crashes in native code, the last exits in the diagnostic report now show the stack Android kept. A freeze lists the main thread's top 40 frames, and a native crash lists its signal and the crashing thread. Android 17's memory limiter and anomaly exits are named too, where the report used to show a bare number.
* Holding one of TikTok's own stickers in a chat now shows Save media in the menu that opens. It saves the full sticker the same way Save in the sticker box does, and turning off `Save box for chat stickers` takes it away too (#470).
* `Show the picture before saving`, under `Save a profile picture on a long press`, opens a held profile picture full screen at full size first. Save under it saves the picture, and a tap anywhere else closes it. It starts off (#467).
* `Report a newer phone to game LIVE` under App tells TikTok's LIVE server you have a Galaxy S25 Ultra while you set up a LIVE. If the server keeps a game LIVE under 1080p 60fps because of your phone, this gives it another chance. It starts off (#459).
* `Seconds per photo` now goes up to 300, so a photo can stay on screen for up to five minutes in a video made from a photo post (#465).
* The "Save photos or a video?" question has a seconds box now, filled in with `Seconds per photo`. Change it there and that video uses it, and so does the next one, with no trip to settings (#465).
* Picking photos and videos together in a photo post asks "Save photos or a video?" too. Save as video makes one video with each picked video playing in its place between the photos and the post's sound under all of it. Save photos still saves each one as it is (#465).
* A video made from a post with just one photo runs as long as the post's sound now, up to five minutes, so the music plays to its end instead of stopping when `Seconds per photo` runs out (#469).
* `Sort pinned videos with the rest` lets a profile's sort put pinned videos in the order with everything else, so Newest first shows them at the date they were posted instead of at the top. It starts off (#466).
* `Hide or reorder profile tabs` (it used to be `Hide profile tabs`) now has arrows on each tab. Move Liked to the top and it's first on your profile, while the tabs you didn't touch stay where TikTok puts them. `Original order` puts TikTok's back (#466).
* `Hide Add bio` under App takes the Add bio prompt off your own profile while it has no bio. Edit profile still lets you add one. It starts off (#466).
* `Hide the people you may know tag` under Feed screen takes that tag away from beside a creator's name. The Friends and Following labels stay (#462).
* `Hide inserted cards` takes the full-screen people you may know card out of For You too. TikTok doesn't even ask for it while the switch is on, and if one shows up anyway it's dropped from the feed (#478).
* `Hide stories from accounts you don't follow` clears the recommended stories TikTok mixes into the Inbox's stories tray. Stories from accounts you follow, and your own, stay (#462).
* `LIVE buttons in the long-press menu` takes Record and Auto tap off the video and puts them in the menu you get by holding the middle of a LIVE. TikTok won't open that menu right after a like, so while Auto tap runs, holding the LIVE stops it instead. Hold again and the menu opens (#359).
* `Fade the name, date and caption` gives the creator's name, the date, the caption and the music line their own opacity over the video (#462).
* `Write the month as a word` shows TikTok's date by the creator's name as Oct 12, or 12 Oct with `Day before month` on (#461).
* `Use an imported emoji font` draws emoji in a font file you pick, separately from the text font. It's part of `Use system font` and needs Android 12 or newer (#458).
* `Video bitrate limit` keeps a heavy video from eating your data. Anything over the limit plays a lighter version, and videos under it aren't touched (#454).
* Double tap and Long press can mark the video on screen as not interested, with the same follow-up choices as the button. It needs the Not interested patch (#452).
* The diagnostic report says when TikTok's main screen starts over while the app is still running, and what happened to the screen before it. That's what a feed jumping back to the top with no crash looks like (#419).
* With `Stop recording watch history` in the patch set, the diagnostic report counts TikTok's view reports, the ones Watch history is built from. It shows how many were made and how many TikTok groups into one send. Then it counts the ones sent on their own, sent together, dropped because TikTok's server told the app to slow down, held back by `Keep videos out of Watch history` or failed, with the last failure's reason (#448).
* The diagnostic report's IMAGE LOADS section counts failed images by how they failed, not one line per picture, so a few hundred refusals from one server read as one line with a count. Request headers in a failure show their names only, never their values. The section also says which country TikTok has placed your phone in and how it decided, next to the SIM country Hushfeed is showing it, so a report can tell when the two don't match (#415).
* `Freeze TikTok's experiments` under App keeps the settings TikTok's servers already sent and ignores new ones, so a layout or feature TikTok starts testing on your account doesn't show up out of nowhere. If something in TikTok stops working, turn it off so the fix can reach you. It starts off. The switch has been in the patches since 0.81.0 without a note here.
* Hushfeed moves to TikTok 47.9.3, and only that one. 47.8.3 isn't supported anymore. Get the 47.9.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with your usual signing key.

### Bug Fixes

* With `Copy the link with one press on Share` on, the Share button's screen reader label says it copies the link as soon as a video shows. Before, it kept TikTok's usual Share label until you'd pressed the button once.
* Searching for a product no longer logs an error, or shows an error toast with diagnostic logging on, when TikTok or the videos themselves mark every result on a page as an advert. The page still shows as TikTok sent it, and the diagnostic report says why. A page where every card carries an advert's shape still counts as an error, since that points at a broken check.
* On a tablet held sideways, opening a profile from search or a picture in the comments no longer flips the screen to portrait. The new `Turn profiles and comment pictures on tablets` patch has both turn with the rest of TikTok wherever TikTok's own check lets its main screen turn. Phones aren't affected (#490).
* With `Translate button in comments` on, the suggested search at the top of the comments stops before the translate button instead of running under it (#479).
* `Translate button in comments` now offers the restart button when you flip it. TikTok keeps one comment sheet for the whole feed and only checks for the button when it builds that sheet, so the change waited for a restart anyway.
* `Remove feed ads` takes another kind of search ad out of the results. Some search ads carry their video tucked inside the card rather than on it, and TikTok itself doesn't call them ads when asked, so they stayed in the grid (#484).
* With `Floating bottom bar` and `Hide the bottom tab names` on, the bar lines each tab up by its icon, and an empty box inside a tab doesn't count as the icon anymore. TikTok's Create tab can carry one, and lining up by it could leave the + sitting higher than the other icons (#474).
* TikTok doesn't freeze and crash anymore with thousands of offline videos saved. Every few minutes TikTok checked how many saved videos were still unwatched by loading all of them, and with a big `Custom offline videos limit` that filled its memory. It asks the database for the number now (#482).
* With `Slide to change the hold speed` on, pulling down to lock keeps the speed the bubble shows on every video. Once a lock carried its speed into the next videos, TikTok counted each of them as locked already, so a slide and a pull there unlocked the video and dropped it to 1x instead. A pull without sliding still unlocks (#485).
* `My watch history` is up to date when you come back to it from a video you opened in it. It used to show the list from before you left until you closed and reopened it.
* The checklist under `Hide Settings and privacy rows` now names the rows the way TikTok 47.9.3 shows them, in the same order as the page, and it has the Visibility and Interactions rows too, like Blocked accounts, Mentions and Direct messages. Before, those showed up under made-up names like "Shared links", and a few others still had their old labels, like Inbox mode for what's now Inbox & Messaging. In German, Italian, Russian and five more languages, Family Pairing now has TikTok's current name too (#244).
* With `Bottom bar height` on anything but TikTok default, the tab icons no longer sit on top of their names. TikTok pads its tabs differently once the bar's room isn't the size it expects, and the new height counted as unexpected, so the icon and the name got pushed into each other. On a taller bar they keep the same gap as on TikTok's own bar now. On a shorter one they shrink a little with the bar, so the selected tab's outline still fits around them.
* With `Bottom bar height` on Tall or Taller, the search strip at the bottom of a video no longer slides under the bar, and on Short or Shorter it no longer floats above the bar with a gap. The caption, the strip and its progress line keep TikTok's distance from the bar at every height now.
* TikTok no longer crashes a few seconds after launch on some phones with "Final field cannot be written to". The Feed filter's check on videos TikTok saved for later wrote a value TikTok had marked read-only (#472).
* With `Log diagnostics` on, Hushfeed settings no longer log a failure for the App icon row each time the page opens or refreshes. It stays out of the diagnostic report, and `Show failures on screen` doesn't pop an error for it anymore. That row saves nothing, so it was never a missing setting.
* `Copy quick report` puts the report together in the background, so the settings page no longer stalls while it reads saved crashes. The other patch bundles line is filled in on the first copy too, where it used to ask you to copy again.
* Native crash lines in the diagnostic report keep their function names. A name like `HttpNetworkSession::GetSocketPool` read as a session value and was blanked.
* The Feature gate lab's list of TikTok settings is right where TikTok's code branches. A few entries were named after a setting loaded on another path, or showed another setting's default, and some settings read after a jump weren't listed at all.
* `Show account country` and `Block this commenter` show up when you hold a comment on accounts where TikTok is trying out its newer share-style comment menu. That menu never got the rows. With either switch on, TikTok opens its regular menu instead, and the share button on comments stays (#417).
* With `Keep the middle unstretched` on, search results play in the app's window like the feed does. A search video on a layer of its own used to leave every video cropped and stretched until the next restart (#468).
* With `Keep the middle unstretched` on, a video's cover picture keeps the same size as its video. When TikTok played a video on a layer of its own, the cover could still take the whole screen, so it showed at the wrong size and flickered as the video replaced it. Once that happens the video and its cover are both cropped and stretched evenly, and the diagnostic report says so (#468).
* Searching the settings for `SIM country preset`, or just "preset", finds that row now. It used to find nothing.
* With `Auto-advance videos` and `Keep playing in the background` both on, a creator's videos keep coming after you start one from their profile and leave the app. TikTok used to play that first video and stop. `Auto-advance session limit` counts these too, and screen-time holds stop them the same way (D292).
* A copy made with Morphe's `Clone app` can log in with the default selection now. `Run beside the store app` is part of Simple mode, and it does nothing on a copy that keeps TikTok's own package name. Without it, TikTok's servers wouldn't give the renamed copy a device ID, so every login said you'd hit the maximum number of attempts (#455, #284).
* The date and length on profile grids don't get cut in half anymore. The label's bar now grows when it needs a third line (#449, #462).
* Patching no longer stops at `Settings` when TikTok's Open Debug row can't be found. You lose only the Hushfeed row in TikTok's settings, and holding Home still opens the page (#460).
* `Save episodes` loads a mini drama's episode list again. It used to stop at "Couldn't load the episodes" (#463).
* The `Save episodes` list goes past the free episodes of a drama you haven't unlocked, and saving one of those gets the whole episode. TikTok's list sends those episodes without their video, so Hushfeed asks for each one on its own instead of stopping at "This video isn't available as a complete file" (#463).
* When TikTok's server turns down every copy of an original photo, `Download original photos` saves the copy TikTok shows on screen instead of stopping at "None of the photos could be saved" (#464).
* With `Hide suggested accounts` on, following someone doesn't leave an empty Suggested accounts box on their profile anymore. Turn on `Keep suggestions on profiles` if you'd rather keep that row while the other suggestions stay hidden (#462).
* `Play original audio` also covers videos TikTok dubs with a whole second copy of the video, which is how some mini dramas get theirs. Saving one of those with the switch on keeps the original sound too (#463, #444).
* The note on the `White on black`, `Black on white` and `Material You` app icons, and on themed icons, has clean round edges now. TikTok's own note has dents that its colored echoes normally cover.
* `Keep captions in Clear display` shows a video's first caption right away, sits near TikTok's own caption spot when it hasn't seen one yet, and stays above the progress bar (#456).
* The country and date line doesn't get cut off anymore when you open a long caption, and the caption above it keeps every line after you open or close it with more and less (#457).
* `Show the country and date under the caption` keeps the two together on photo posts and on videos with no caption. With no caption they go right under the creator's name (#453).
* A sorted profile grid loads up to 1,000 videos on its own before it sorts, up from 300, so a long profile's oldest and longest videos make it into the order. On a long profile that takes around 35 seconds. Tap the loading grid to see the order it has right away, and your scrolling loads the rest. A slow connection stops after 45 seconds the same way. The notes under the profile and sound page sort settings say 1,000 now too, where they still said 300 (#180).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the Unmute and Remove buttons in a LIVE's Muted and Blocked lists show their label in white. The buttons are a see-through gray on the dark sheet and the label stayed dark gray on them, so you could barely read it (#362).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, every row of a LIVE's Muted, Blocked and Moderation lists stays readable as you scroll. Rows the list brought in while scrolling kept their dark gray text on the dark sheet, and the readable ones seemed to jump around as the list reused them (#362).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, an outlined button on a LIVE settings page gets a white outline with its label inside it. The white filled the whole button, so the Moderation list's buttons showed up as blank white boxes (#362).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the "Find an open guest spot" bar under a LIVE guest's card reads light on a dark gray bar. TikTok always draws that bar in its light colors, so its text and arrow were black on the black sheet (#362).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a pinned comment's Pinned and timer tags sit right on the video again, the way they look with the switch off. They still had pale see-through pills behind them, because the comment's rows took the colors meant for the dark panels (#362).

### Build

* The Settings patch marks itself applied in one place for TikTok and TikTok Lite, after the last of its changes went in. Lite's half used to do it on its own, which broke the check that every patch does that last, and that check had failed since Lite support came in.
* The GitHub release notes leave out the Build changes and the What was checked list now. Build changes are still listed here in the changelog.
* The build runs on Gradle 9.9.1, which fixes the three Gradle security advisories published on November 10. The wrapper jar and the distribution checksum come from services.gradle.org.
* The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.5.0, the one stable Morphe Manager 2.7.0 and morphe-desktop 2.3.0 ship. Bundles from now on need Manager 2.7.0 or newer, and the README and the bug form say so.
* Patching for a phone, the full patch check and the release tools work again now that some patches also name TikTok Lite. They read TikTok as the target because every patch names it, and Lite's versions no longer count. Before this they stopped with "Expected one compatible package".
* The register check that runs after patching accepts the 47.9.3 APK. It still expected 47.9.2's checksum, and moving to a new TikTok build now swaps that checksum along with the version.
* The scripts that move the patches to a new TikTok build are in `scripts/retarget/` now. `retarget.ps1` takes the old and new fixture folders and runs the whole renaming pass, and concepts/patch-development.md says how to read what it reports.
* `Custom offline videos limit` stops the patch with an error if TikTok ever puts a branch between its clean-up answer and the return the patch rewrites. The check for that never matched an if or a goto before.
* The README's advice for a 32-bit Manager now says to patch the bundle and leave out the patches you don't need. It used to say every patch fits once AMOLED dark theme's `Switch in Hushfeed settings` is off, which came from 1 GB tests on a computer. On a phone running a 32-bit Manager 2.7.0 (1.5 GB for the patcher), TikTok 47.9.3's APK ran out of memory about halfway through every patch with that option on or off.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. The AMOLED dark mode switch in Hushfeed settings > App starts on, and turning it off brings TikTok's own dark grays back.

options.description: Adds AMOLED dark mode to Hushfeed settings > App, so you can go back to TikTok's own dark grays without patching again. Turn this off if a 32-bit Morphe Manager runs out of memory: AMOLED then stays on, and the switch is left out.
Pick a color, or type a solid color code like #000000. Black lets OLED screens turn those pixels off completely.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Unread dots and counts change with it. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. The feed's like heart and save bookmark can take colors of their own. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

options.description: Pick a preset, or type a solid color code like #2D7FF9. TikTok original leaves the red as it is. TikTok's lighter and darker reds follow the color you pick.
The heart on a video you liked, in the feed and in its tap animation. TikTok original leaves it red. It works in light, dark and AMOLED alike, with or without a new accent.
The bookmark on a video you saved to Favorites, in the feed and in its animation. TikTok original leaves it yellow.

On Android 12 and up, buttons and red text take the color of the phone's wallpaper theme and change when the wallpaper does, and the color above is not used. Android 11 and older keep TikTok's red. The soft see-through reds stay as they are.

patches.name: Account cleanup
patches.description: Adds Remove all reposts, Remove all likes, Clear Favorites, Remove all comments, Remove selected comments and Unfollow accounts that don't follow you back to Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Each one takes items off your account one at a time through TikTok's own requests, with a pause between them, and stops on the first error. A switch there also lets one tap remove a video from your own Liked videos, Favorites or Reposts.

patches.name: Advanced downloads
patches.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story, a video's cover or a mini drama's episodes from the share sheet, put a save button on the video, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads. The save button's switch is in Feed screen > Buttons on videos.

patches.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Always show publish date
patches.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, hide the view counts there, sort the videos a grid has loaded, start your Liked grid at a year or month you pick, or add a drag handle and jump buttons to long grids. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Always upload in HD
patches.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: App lock
patches.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Automatic video advance
patches.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Block P2P video relay
patches.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 4.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches.name: Block author button
patches.description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Block contact list access
patches.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Block installed app scanning
patches.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Block popups
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon, up to 50 characters.

patches.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches.description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Comment send fix
patches.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Comment sort controls
patches.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Comment tools
patches.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches.description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, makes the @names in a bio open those profiles on a tap, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a display name, username, user ID or video ID. On a profile card inside a LIVE room, long-press the bio or the name to copy it, long-press the username for the user ID, or tap the copy mark by the username. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Copy comments without username
patches.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Create stickers
patches.description: Adds a Create button to the Saved page of the comment sticker panel. Pick a photo and it turns into one of your saved stickers. Make sticker in a video's share sheet opens TikTok's sticker editor for any video, or uses its cover when the editor can't open. Profiles that have stickers keep their Stickers tab, and it opens their sticker sets. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Custom launcher icon
patches.description: Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain, Material You, any background color or your own picture, and put Hushfeed's H in the status bar. Only patching again without it puts the old icons back.

options.description: TikTok colors keeps the icon as it is. Black background puts TikTok's note on pure black, and the two plain styles draw only the note in one color. Material You colors the note and its background from your wallpaper on Android 12 and up, light or dark with the system, even with themed icons off, and is white on black before that. Every style gets the themed icon.
A color like #1E88E5 to put behind the note, or behind your picture, instead of the style's own. Leave it empty to keep the style's.

Where to find a square PNG picture of your own, 432 to 1024 pixels on each side, to use instead of TikTok's note. Home screens trim icons to their own shape, so keep what matters in the middle two thirds. With a picture, the style only sets the color behind it and there's no themed icon. A folder works too when the picture is the only PNG in it or is named icon.png. Leave it empty to keep the note.
The small icon TikTok's notifications show in the status bar. TikTok's note keeps it as it is. Hushfeed's H swaps it for a sharp H on every screen.

Puts every icon style in Hushfeed's settings under Appearance, so you can switch the home screen icon without patching again. A picture or background color you set here shows up there as Your icon and starts as the one in use. Android 8 and up. Some home screens drop the icon when it changes, so add it back from the app list.

patches.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Device privacy guard
patches.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches.name: Diagnostic tools
patches.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Disable login requirement
patches.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Disable the long press repost
patches.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Double-tap controls
patches.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, name the song with Shazam, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Each corner of the video can get its own action too. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Enable voice comments
patches.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Expand activity list
patches.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches.name: Feed tab navigation
patches.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, put Discover in the bottom bar and Friends in the top tabs, rename the bottom tabs, pick the bottom bar's icons and height, choose the tab TikTok opens on, stop For You reloading when you tap Home and hold Profile to open your Watch history. Starts off, except holding Home to open Hushfeed settings. Find it in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs.

patches.name: Feed text sizes
patches.description: Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, or give them a color and a backdrop, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick them in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. Four more switches cover the whole screen instead. One crops the video, one stretches it, one does a little of each and one keeps the middle at its own shape and stretches only the top and bottom. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Fix Google login
patches.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Fix Spotify login
patches.description: Makes Add to Spotify work in the patched app. The Spotify app turns down a patched TikTok, so you sign in on Spotify's own page instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Fix notifications on OPPO, OnePlus and realme
patches.description: On OPPO, OnePlus and realme phones TikTok can send its notifications through OPPO's push service, which only delivers to TikTok as TikTok signed it, not to a patched copy. This has TikTok use Google's push service on those phones, like it does on other phones. Other phones don't change. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Foldable split comment view
patches.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Follow diagnostics
patches.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Freeze TikTok's experiments
patches.description: Lets you keep the settings TikTok's servers sent it so far. TikTok tests new layouts and features on people by sending new ones all the time, and with this on it ignores them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Ghost mode
patches.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. Each of the three has its own switch under it, and separate ones hide your online status, let you watch LIVEs unseen and keep your likes on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Group likes per comment
patches.description: Shows one row in the Inbox's Likes list for each comment or video people liked, with everyone counted, instead of a new row every few likes. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches.name: Hide already seen videos
patches.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. It can also keep a watch history you can search and reopen videos from. Both stay on your phone. Starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches.description: Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen, and can stop a right swipe on For You from opening the side menu. Each has its own switch, and all start off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide feed follow button
patches.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide feed save button
patches.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide feed search button
patches.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed and the one over the video while comments are open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide floating promotions
patches.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches.name: Hide inbox items
patches.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop, the stories row and the On this day memory in it, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications and TikTok's Main, Requests, Unread and Starred tabs on any account, a way to rebuild message search, room to pin more than 5 chats and the time under each chat message. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide inbox stories
patches.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and the profile tabs you pick, like Reposts or Liked videos, with the tabs that stay in your order. It can hide the Thoughts bubble and the Add bio prompt, plus Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: Stops TikTok telling people you've read their messages. Your own unread badges still clear as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide search suggestions
patches.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches.name: Hide video overlays
patches.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Keep a streak going
patches.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Keep playing in the background
patches.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. If you only want it on some videos, a second switch adds TikTok's own row to the long-press menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Keep recent stickers
patches.description: Adds Recently used above Saved in the comment sticker panel, with the last stickers you sent, and keeps it when you close and reopen the app. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Keep the app language
patches.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Keep the next videos in full screen
patches.description: From most pages, TikTok's full screen view opens with only the video you were on, so there's nothing to swipe to and it can't move on by itself. This brings the videos after it along. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Keep the screen's brightness in the camera
patches.description: Stops TikTok from turning your screen brighter while you film, edit or post a video. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. TikTok doesn't ask on every phone, and where it doesn't, this changes nothing. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Keep unsent messages
patches.description: Keeps a message in your chat when the other person unsends it, instead of removing it, and can mark it as unsent. A button removes the kept messages. Messages you unsend yourself are still removed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: LIVE controls
patches.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count and battle scores instead of rounded ones, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it (or hides that row altogether), can hide the AI summary on LIVE previews, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches.name: Lift text length limits
patches.description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Limit background traffic
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

options.description: With this on, the Limit background traffic switch in Hushfeed settings also stops TikTok setting up notifications, so you won't get any, messages included. Turn the switch off or pause Hushfeed to get them back.

patches.name: Load all saved stickers
patches.description: Loads every sticker you saved in one go when you open the sticker panel, instead of the first 100. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Location access governor
patches.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Long-press controls
patches.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, name the song with Shazam, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Look like the store app
patches.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Mute feed videos
patches.description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos, or keep the sound and let other apps play until a video starts and after you leave it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. HTTP and SOCKS5 both work, with or without a password. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Network request report
patches.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches.name: Not interested button
patches.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Notification controls
patches.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Open external links directly
patches.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Open the comments at full height
patches.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture
patches.description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Play original audio
patches.description: Plays videos and mini dramas with their original audio instead of TikTok's AI dub in your app language. Captions and translations stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Playback quality
patches.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Profile background
patches.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Region spoof
patches.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches.name: Remember clear display
patches.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches.description: Removes the script for games inside LIVEs and turns off animated gift effects. It saves very little space. The catch: LIVE games and animated gifts may stop working. Co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, invitations and battle scores aren't touched.

patches.name: Remove avatar rings
patches.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. It can also open a LIVE creator's Story from their profile picture or their chat in the Inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches.description: Removes TikTok's payment card scanner and content credential files, saving about 11 MB of storage. Anything in TikTok that needs them may stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches.name: Remove creation tools
patches.description: Removes two effects engine libraries TikTok doesn't load for the camera, effects, Retouch or the video editor, saving about 45 MB. Those all keep working. If a creation tool ever closes TikTok, repatch without this one.

patches.name: Remove unused language packs
patches.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

options.description: The languages to keep, as short codes separated by commas, like en, es, pt, fr or de. Type all to keep every language. English is always kept.

patches.name: Remove voice tools
patches.description: Removes TikTok's speech recognition files, saving about 16 MB of storage. The catch: voice search, naming a song by listening, talking to TikTok's AI assistant and TikTok's music check on videos you post all stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches.name: Report a newer phone to effects
patches.description: Tells TikTok's effects server you have a newer phone, so effects it turns down on older phones get another chance. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Report a newer phone to game LIVE
patches.description: Tells TikTok's LIVE server you have a newer phone while you set up a LIVE, so a game LIVE can offer qualities it holds back from some phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Repost diagnostics
patches.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resource and battery governor
patches.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Run beside the store app
patches.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. It does nothing unless Clone app renamed the package. If Google sign-in fails in the copy, use email or phone.

patches.name: SIM spoof
patches.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Settings
patches.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off, and pick any of TikTok's own Settings and privacy rows to hide. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Share sheet tools
patches.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches.name: Show LIVE search
patches.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Show author region
patches.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Show engagement rate
patches.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Show exact counts
patches.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Show follow status
patches.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App. Separate switches add the month an account was made and what changed on a profile since your last visit. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches.name: Show the progress bar
patches.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Skip content warnings
patches.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Skip the splash ad
patches.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Skip update checks
patches.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Smaller text sizes
patches.description: Adds three stops below the smallest size on TikTok's own Text size slider, for smaller text and more on screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then pick a stop in Settings and privacy > Accessibility > Text size and restart TikTok.

patches.name: Split activity list
patches.description: Shows the Inbox's Activity page as two lists, your newest comments on top and likes below, each scrolling on its own, with a bar between them that swaps them or hides the lower one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop recording watch history
patches.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop saving search history
patches.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop search autoplay
patches.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Stop video looping
patches.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Story controls
patches.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Subtitle tools
patches.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, bring back TikTok's captions switch where it's missing, skip the part of a video whose caption has a promo word you list, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, Feed filter for promo words, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches.name: Swipe-left controls
patches.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments, open the popup that saves it to one of your collections, or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Translate comments
patches.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches.name: Trust user certificates
patches.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches.name: Turn off haptics
patches.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Turn profiles and comment pictures on tablets
patches.description: On a tablet where TikTok lets its main screen turn, a profile opened from search and a comment's picture turn with it instead of flipping the screen to portrait. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: UI scale
patches.description: Makes TikTok's whole interface smaller, text and buttons alike, so more fits on screen. Starts at 100%, which changes nothing. Pick a size in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Use non-personalized search
patches.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Block contact list access
patches.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Block installed app scanning
patches.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon, up to 50 characters.

patches.name: Diagnostic tools
patches.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Network request report
patches.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches.name: Settings
patches.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off, and pick any of TikTok's own Settings and privacy rows to hide. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Trust user certificates
patches.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.
